g.text: x axis: absolute difference in the coordinate, divided by the median absolute difference of the same coordinate

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: over the 199,985 random pairs (seed 42); 1 (dotted) is therefore the random-pair median.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Every value of both sets is drawn — no truncation, no dropped points — and each panel is scaled to the full

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: range of its own two groups, so the six x ranges differ.
